vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: dr-context-pipeline
Version: 1.0.1

The skill bundle defines a structured RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipeline for managing agent memory and context. It utilizes deterministic routing (router.yml), JSON schemas for data validation, and specific prompt engineering (compressor_prompt.txt) to transform raw memory snippets into a 'Context Pack.' There are no indicators of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or harmful prompt injection; the logic is entirely focused on optimizing context window usage and ensuring factual grounding in agent responses.

llm.summary: The skill is internally consistent: its files, prompts, and schemas match the declared purpose of building a deterministic file-backed retrieval → compression pipeline, and it does not request extra credentials or install code.

dimensions.detail: Name/description, router.yml, compressor prompt, and schemas all align: the skill standardizes routing, retrieval, deterministic snippet IDs, compression to a Context Pack, linting, and golden tests. There are no unrelated environment variables, binaries, or install steps requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs the agent to load local file-based memory (memory/always_on.md and memory/topics/*), build a Retrieval Bundle, compress it with the provided compressor prompt, and lint against the included schemas. All referenced files are bundled with the skill; there are no instructions to read unrelated system files, contact external endpoints, or access secrets beyond the local memory files.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files — the skill is instruction-only (prompts, schemas, YAML, tests). That minimizes disk-write/execute risk.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requires no environment variables, credentials, or config paths. The only data it expects is a file-based memory layout, which is appropriate for its stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not request forced inclusion or modify other skills. The included configure_prompt.md instructs a user to copy the protocol into another agent if desired — an expected convenience but user-driven.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and instruction-only, but review the memory files the agent will read before enabling it. The pipeline will load memory/always_on.md and topic files verbatim — do not store secrets or sensitive tokens there. Verify your agent's filesystem access and permissions so only intended files are retrievable. If you plan to paste the configure_prompt.md into other agents, ensure you trust those agents and/or update the always-on policy header to avoid leaking sensitive invariants. Finally, run the supplied golden tests and schema validations in a safe environment to confirm the behavior before using it with high-stakes or production data.
